# Generated by ppc worldbuilder (navigation_scripts.py); do not edit by hand.
# The vanilla sense of "coastal": the location borders water that is not a navigable river channel. The channels
# are sea zones in region pp_navigation_region, so is_coastal alone is also true on every river bank.
pp_is_sea_coast = {
	is_coastal = yes
	any_neighbor_location = {
		is_land = no
		NOT = { region = region:pp_navigation_region }
	}
}
